ui_bugs.issue: Header badge data-testid='sync-queue' (shows 'N na fila' when offline + queue>0) did not render in the verification flow even though pncd_sync_queue had 1 item, offline-badge was visible, and the per-form 'Aguardando envio' badge rendered correctly. The per-form badge fulfills the user-visible requirement, but the header counter never appeared. Likely a state-sync race between subscribeSyncState() initial callback and the online/offline transitions during in-app navigation; suggest also re-reading getQueue() inside the useEffect that subscribes (defensive) or recomputing syncState on the same online/offline events the badge depends on.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking save-btn in offline mode the request still queues correctly (sync_queue=1, local_forms=1, form appears on Dashboard, online drain works) but the toast 'Sem internet — salvo na fila local' (data-testid='toast') was not captured in the DOM after the save — appears to be dismissed or skipped on the offline path. Functional impact: none, save behaviour is correct. UX impact: user gets no confirmation that the form was queued locally.

action_items: (LOW) Header 'sync-queue' / 'sync-pending' badge: ensure subscribeSyncState callback fires after Dashboard mount when localStorage already has queued items — current per-form 'Aguardando envio' badge works, but the header counter is silent. Consider calling setSyncState({queueSize:getQueue().length,…}) from the same useEffect that subscribes, or listening to 'storage' events as well.

(LOW) Offline save toast 'Sem internet — salvo na fila local' was not observed — verify the toast is actually scheduled on the offline branch of save (FormEditor handleSave) and not skipped/overwritten by the subsequent navigate('/').
critical_code_review_comments: syncQueue.drainQueue (lib/syncQueue.js:128) correctly catches per-op errors and keeps failed ops in remaining[], but on a partial failure subsequent untried ops are NOT preserved — the loop completes all queue items in order; OK. However, queueUpdateForm allows updates against tempIds and drainQueue silently skips them as already-handled; if an update is made AFTER an outgoing create in the same offline session, the update payload is lost (only the create payload is replayed). Suggest: when queueing an update on a tempId, replace the create payload in-place instead of appending a no-op update.

api.formsApi.list() (lib/api.js:55) merges local + server but only de-duplicates by id. Local forms always have id starting with 'local_' so collisions are impossible — OK. Sorting uses updated_at which both sides set; safe.

catalogApi.prefetchQuarteirao (lib/api.js:146) returns Promise.resolve() for falsy quarteirao — good. Currently FormEditor fires it for every unique quarteirao on every render of visits; verified 4 calls for 3 visits across 2 unique quarteirões — that's 2 calls per useEffect run, suggesting the effect ran twice (likely React 18 StrictMode dev double-invoke). Not a bug in prod.
Resumo.jsx computes stats client-side from /api/imoveis + /api/imoveis/visited; OK for 988 imóveis. If catalog grows above ~10k consider a /api/forms/summary aggregation endpoint.

PrintD1.jsx: tipo 'P.E.' totals are computed from visit.tipo_imovel==='PE' — confirm matches the constants in d1.js (TIPOS_IMOVEL). Verified visually: P.E. column shows 0 for the seeded form, consistent with the 3 real visits (2 C + 1 R).

Dashboard.jsx: useEffect on `online` (line 25-29) triggers trySync on every online flip — could race with a save that's still being committed if the user toggles connectivity rapidly. Low risk in real use; acceptable.
@media print CSS (index.css): @page A4 landscape applied; verified '.no-print' selector is in use (1 instance — the header toolbar with back/print buttons). Looks correct.

rca of the issue: Header 'sync-queue' badge not appearing: Dashboard subscribes to subscribeSyncState on mount and the helper does call fn(...) synchronously with current localStorage snapshot. The most likely RCA is that when the user navigates in-app (e.g., /resumo → back) the Dashboard remounts while online state from useOnline() hasn't yet flipped to false (the offline event was dispatched while on /resumo and the Dashboard's useOnline hook had been unmounted then). So at the moment subscribeSyncState fires, queueSize=1 but `online` is still true (initial useState value from navigator.onLine which we had set offline only briefly). Net effect: condition `queueSize > 0 && !online` is false → no badge. The companion condition `queueSize > 0 && online` would fire 'sync-pending' but only after the online useEffect runs trySync(), which immediately drains the queue → queueSize back to 0 → still no badge. Mitigation: in Dashboard's online useEffect (line 25), set syncState to fresh value BEFORE trySync to give the badge one render cycle, or expose syncing state from trySync so 'Sincronizando…' shows during the drain regardless of queue length.
